prompt: By default the v6 model with a 5-second 720p 16:9 clip will be used.

PixVerse V6 with integrated audio and multi-shot storytelling. A dramatic courtroom scene with multiple camera angles. For all parameters see https://useapi.net/docs/api-pixverse-v2/post-pixverse-videos-create-v4
Image-to-video: the local image is uploaded via POST files and passed as first_frame_path. Note: aspect_ratio is derived from the image and must NOT be set for i2v.

Third-party models (seedance-2.0, kling-o3, veo-3.1-fast, sora-2, grok-imagine, happyhorse-1.0, …) are selectable via the model field. They reject native-only flags such as off_peak_mode, preview_mode, multi_shot and seed.
